title: Patrick Mahomes: Eric Bieniemy's return has been exciting to me

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Patrick Mahomes: Eric Bieniemy's return has been exciting to me
sources.description: After the Chiefs finished last season 6-11 and missed the postseason for the first time since 2014, the club made several coaching changes, headlined by the return of Eric Bieniemy as offensive coordinator.
